channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: DOJ gets authority to seize or restrain $1.2B in Binance funds
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion tied to Binance’s $6 billion theft, as tracing continues.

item.title: Alta raises $47.5 million for institutional blockchain
item.description: Alta raised a $47.5 million Series A to build a blockchain using recursive zero-knowledge cryptography, with Airwallex set to connect payment rails and stablecoin flows.

item.title: Visa adds Monad for institutional stablecoin settlement
item.description: Visa added Monad for participating issuers and acquirers to settle obligations in stablecoins, widening its blockchain options while leaving merchant card flows unchanged.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, while a planned privacy feature for institutional payments remains in development.

item.title: Coinbase’s OCC trust charter takes effect for custody business
item.description: Coinbase’s OCC trust charter took effect Nov. 6, placing its fiduciary digital-asset custody business under federal supervision without authorizing deposit-taking.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, moving mainnet to 25-second blocks
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target spacing to 25 seconds and changing subsidy, fee-reserve and transaction-validity rules.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34B theft from malware to fake job interview
item.description: Binance says a months-long intrusion used a fake recruiting process and compromised wallet infrastructure to authorize $6.34 billion in transfers beyond normal withdrawals.

item.title: FBI attributes $6B Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI named North Korea’s TraderTraitor in Binance’s $6.34 billion theft; EIP-7702 authorizations let attackers keep moving funds after withdrawals stopped.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7 with 25-second block targets
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block spacing to 25 seconds while adding shielded-action limits and changing how fees support miners.

item.title: Polygon bridge approvals: one deposit or many
item.description: A Polygon bridge deposit may need one ERC-20 approval and then a separate deposit; the allowance can cover one transfer or repeated deposits until spent or revoked.

item.title: Greece approves 10% tax on individual crypto gains
item.description: Greece's parliament approved a 10% tax on individual crypto gains, with a €500 annual exemption; calculation and audit rules will follow in ministerial directives.

item.title: What chainlist changes when one wallet spans EVM chains
item.description: Chainlist can add an EVM network to a wallet by submitting its chain ID and RPC details for approval; the wallet still controls the active chain, signing and funds.

item.title: SEC staff calls Canton Coin a digital commodity
item.description: SEC staff views Canton Coin as a digital commodity and will not recommend enforcement over specified programmatic minting, tying both positions to facts Canton supplied.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34 billion breach to fake job interview
item.description: Binance says a fake interview helped attackers reach its wallet signing service and move $6.34 billion; EIP-7702 permissions outlasted its withdrawal shutdown.

item.title: Binance says EIP-7702 wallet attack moved $6.34 billion
item.description: Binance says attackers used its wallet signing service and EIP-7702 delegations to move $6.34 billion; it reports freezing $2.85 billion and replenishing 98% of assets.

item.title: When Should You Harvest DeFi Farm Rewards?
item.description: Harvest when expected reward value clears gas, slippage and reinvestment costs; batching claims around fee conditions usually beats a fixed daily schedule.

item.title: Binance reopens more withdrawals after $6.3bn hot-wallet theft
item.description: Binance is reopening withdrawals in phases after a $6.3bn hot-wallet theft, adding assets only after security checks as its investigation continues.

item.title: Binance reopens crypto withdrawals in phases after $6.3B theft
item.description: Binance began phased withdrawal restoration after its hot wallets lost about $6.3 billion; the exchange says it has replenished roughly 95% while its investigation continues.

item.title: Binance starts phased withdrawal reopening after $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance plans a phased withdrawal restart after a $6.3 billion wallet breach, while investigators trace stolen funds across ten blockchain networks.

item.title: FBI ties Binance’s $6.3 billion theft to TraderTraitor
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets; the FBI attributes the record crypto theft to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor.
